heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Rights of widower.
article.content:
35Rights of widower.

Section 35  ·  Part V · Chapter II  ·  page 23 of the Act
A husband surviving his wife has the same rights in respect of her property, if she dies intestate, as a widow has in respect of her husband’s property, if he dies intestate.
